question: Combien de clients habitent en France ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'France'

question: Quelle est la piste la plus longue ?
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: Quel est le montant moyen d'une facture ?
Combien de pistes durent plus de 5 minutes ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000

question: Quels sont les albums du groupe AC/DC ?
sql: SELECT Album.Title FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId WHERE Artist.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: Combien de pistes appartiennent au genre Jazz ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track JOIN Genre ON Track.GenreId = Genre.GenreId WHERE Genre.Name = 'Jazz'

question: Quels sont les 2 pays qui ont le plus de factures ?
sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 2

question: Quels sont les 3 artistes qui ont le plus d'albums ?
sql: SELECT Artist.Name FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires de chaque année ?
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY 1

question: Quels pays comptent au moins 5 clients ?
sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

question: Quels sont les noms de famille des 5 clients qui ont dépensé le plus ?
sql: SELECT Customer.LastName FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Invoice.CustomerId = Customer.CustomerId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(Invoice.Total) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Pour chaque employé qui suit des clients, donne son nom de famille et le nombre de clients qu'il suit.
sql: SELECT Employee.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM Employee JOIN Customer ON Customer.SupportRepId = Employee.EmployeeId GROUP BY Employee.EmployeeId

question: Combien d'artistes n'ont aucun album ?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

question: Quel artiste a généré le plus de revenus ?
sql: SELECT Artist.Name FROM InvoiceLine JOIN Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId JOIN Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(InvoiceLine.UnitPrice * InvoiceLine.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1
